IEX.thesis_one_line: Makes specialised pumps, meters and valves; orders are surging and guidance is rising, but the price already assumes about nine percent yearly cash growth.
kill_criteria: Organic orders growth below 0% YoY for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: +28%).
FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance ("$8.70 to $8.85" in July 2026) cut below $8.35 (the April 2026 low end), or Q3 2026 adjusted EPS below $2.20.
Consolidated gross borrowings above 2.75x TTM adjusted EBITDA (now about 1.9x: $1,866.9M vs $969.4M), or a debt-funded acquisition above $1B.
HST organic sales growth below 3% for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: +12%).
Adjusted EBITDA margin below 26.0% for two consecutive quarters excluding tariff refunds (Q2 2026: 28.1%, of which 130 bp is refund benefit).
key_adverse_facts: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.32 includes a one-off $0.08 benefit (and 150 bp of gross margin) from IEEPA tariff refunds; GAAP EPS $1.93 vs adjusted $2.32, a 17% gap mostly acquired-intangible amortisation (release accession 0000832101-26-000019).
FMT and FSDP (55% of Q2 2026 sales, consolidated) grew only +1% and -1% organically; growth is concentrated in HST on AI data-center and semiconductor demand.

FY2025 guidance was cut in July 2025 (adjusted EPS $8.10-$8.45 to $7.85-$7.95); management turnover: interim CFO until Jan 2026, Chief Strategy Officer role eliminated Feb 2026, director resigned Aug 2026.
Consolidated goodwill $3,382.6M plus intangibles $1,164.5M are about 66% of total assets $6,930.0M; buybacks partly revolver-funded ($205.0M drawn in H1 2026).
data_conflicts: Triage price/growth call: orders +28% organic and two guidance raises are stronger than the triage text implied; verdict still WATCH on price.
Triage +43% 12-month run matches b1 12-1 month momentum (+42.6%), not a full 12-month return.
Yahoo-derived d4 trailing EPS $6.96 is GAAP; adjusted TTM EPS is $8.45 (sum of Q3 2025-Q2 2026 releases).
Next earnings date 2026-10-28 is a d4 estimate, not confirmed by the company.
IEX.confidence_in_thesis: medium: clean balance sheet (covenant leverage 1.87x) and four beats, but valuation gap to base case is small and the orders surge is AI-cycle dependent; call transcripts and risk-factor diffs not reviewed

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for IEX. Reverse DCF (9% discount rate, 3% terminal, owner FCF $611M) implies 9.3% a year of FCF growth for ten years versus my base of about 8%; base 3-year return 6.6% a year is below a 9% hurdle, so WATCH with entry near $215.

IEX.scenario_basis: Start FY2026 adjusted EPS $8.775 (guide midpoint, incl. $0.08 one-off), price $230.08; bear EPS +3%/yr, exit 18x NTM; base EPS +11%/+9%/+8.5%, exit 22x; bull EPS +15%/+12%/+11%, exit 26x; dividend $2.92 growing 2%/3%/5%.

PNW.thesis_one_line: Arizona electric utility with fast-growing demand, but heavy borrowing, constant share issuance and a pending rate decision leave little margin of safety at today's price.
kill_criteria: ACC final order on the 2025 rate case with ROE below 9.3% or a total base revenue increase below $350M (request $691.6M; staff $506.5M).
Pinnacle West consolidated debt to total capitalisation above 64% (10-Q covenant maximum 65%; 62% at 30 Jun 2026).
Any downgrade of Pinnacle West senior unsecured below Baa2 at Moody's or BBB at S&P, or either agency moving its outlook to negative (now Baa2 and BBB, both stable).
2026 weather-normalized EPS guidance ("$4.55 to $4.75") cut below $4.55.
Diluted share count growth above 4% year over year (about +2.5% in Q2 2026) without matching EPS growth.
key_adverse_facts: Consolidated debt-to-capitalisation about 62% vs a 65% covenant maximum (Pinnacle West); APS long-term debt carrying $8.74B vs a $9.5B ACC limit, with a request to raise it to $12B pending (10-Q accession 0000764622-26-000041).

Consolidated free cash flow about -$878M TTM (OCF $1,771.1M less capex $2,649.5M) before about $376M of construction contributions; consolidated short-term borrowings plus current maturities $1.59B vs cash $9.1M.
Equity issuance: $900M at-the-market programme substantially complete with about $816M unsettled forwards, plus a new $500M programme (8-K accession 0001104659-26-090108); diluted shares +2.5% YoY.

Pending 2025 rate case: APS asks 10.70% ROE and $608.7M net increase; ACC Staff recommends 9.55%-9.80% and $506.5M total base revenue; RUCO 9.00%-9.20% and $200.2-278.1M; consensus FY2027 EPS $5.64 (+20%) depends on the outcome.
Q2 2026 EPS fell 9.5% (net interest charges about +20%, depreciation +6%); consolidated operating lease liabilities $5.1B, up $1.4B in six months.
data_conflicts: Triage net debt/EBITDA 7.7x includes $5.1B consolidated operating lease liabilities; financial debt only is about 5.3x (consolidated $11,369M over Yahoo EBITDA $2,149M).
d4 FCF yield -8.4% vs my TTM FCF of about -$878M (-7.9% of market cap); difference is the capex and contribution definitions.
Consensus FY2027 EPS $5.64 is about 7% above my base $5.26 because staff ROE and revenue recommendations are below the request.
Next earnings date 2026-11-03 is a d4 estimate, not confirmed by the company.
PNW.confidence_in_thesis: low-medium: load growth is real, but the thesis turns on an unresolved ACC order and continued capital-market access; long-term EPS growth target from the call was not obtained

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for PNW. Dividend-discount reverse DCF (8% cost of equity, 3% terminal, $3.64 dividend) implies 5.5% a year of per-share growth versus my base of 5.0%; base 3-year return 7.6% a year is about a utility cost of equity, so WATCH pending the rate order.

PNW.scenario_basis: Start FY2026E GAAP EPS $4.70 (guide $4.55-$4.75 weather-normalized), price $91.74; bear EPS +4%/+3%/+3%, exit 14.5x NTM; base EPS +12%/+7%/+6%, exit 16.5x; bull EPS +20%/+9%/+8%, exit 18.5x; dividend $3.64 growing 1%/2%/3%.

FAST.thesis_one_line: Supplies factories with bolts and tools through on-site vending machines; a superb cash-rich business, but its share price already assumes more growth than likely.
kill_criteria: Daily sales growth below 5% YoY for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: +14.7%).
TTM consolidated operating margin below 19.0% (Q2 2026 TTM: 20.3%, $1,775.2M on $8,749.3M).
Consolidated gross margin below 43.5% in any two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: 44.6%).
TTM consolidated operating cash flow below 75% of TTM net income (now 103%).
FASTBin/FASTVend 2026 signings goal cut below 26,000 MEUs (current goal 27,000-29,000).
key_adverse_facts: Price $50.43 is 37.0x NTM earnings with a 2.0% TTM FCF yield; the sell-side mean target $48.84 is 3.2% below the price.
Gross margin fell 75 bp to 44.6% in Q2 2026 with unfavorable price/cost of about 40 bp; about 290 bp of the 14.7% sales growth is pricing (release accession 0000815556-26-000037).
Q2 2026 operating cash flow was only 69.4% of net income as receivables rose $116.0M in the quarter; receivables +17.6% vs sales +14.7% YoY (consolidated).
The FASTBin/FASTVend 2026 signings goal was cut on 14 Jul 2026 from 28,000-30,000 to 27,000-29,000 MEUs, after a similar cut in July 2025; Q2 signings +8.3% vs sales +14.7%.
data_conflicts: Triage: sell-side target 3.2% below price verified (d4 mean $48.84 vs $50.43).
d4 FCF yield 1.6% vs my TTM FCF yield 2.0% (OCF less gross capex $243.3M); Yahoo uses a different capex definition.
Fastenal reports GAAP only and gives no sales, margin or EPS guidance; only signings, capex and tax-rate statements exist.
Next earnings date 2026-10-14 is a d4 estimate, not confirmed by the company.
FAST.confidence_in_thesis: high on business quality, medium on the valuation call: growth is accelerating and could sustain above my base, but price implies about 17% a year of FCF growth; call transcripts not reviewed

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for FAST. Reverse DCF (9% discount rate, 3% terminal, FCF after SBC $1,146M) implies 17.2% a year of FCF growth for ten years versus my base of 9%; base 3-year return 2.7% a year, so WATCH with a revisit level near $42.
